flags.text: Net profit fell 8.4% a year over 3 years
Free cash flow was negative over 3 years (Rs -573 Cr)

items.quote: The Joint Venture with Superform is progressing well, with commissioning expected in Q1FY27, focusing on agrochemical, paints and coatings applications, which aligns well with our strategy of moving closer to the customer and diversifying application layer.
items.target: Augene Superform JV commissioning on track in H1FY27
items.actual: Commissioning slipped from Q1 FY27 to Q2 FY27 and commercial production remained pending as of November 2026.
items.note: The Augene/Superform JV missed its Q1 FY27 target when management shifted it to Q2 FY27 in August 2026, and commercial production was still expected soon as of November 2026.

items.quote: Given the fast-growing business environment for this segment, we have taken steadfast measures to further scale up the capacities from about 290+KT to about 360 KT and expect the same to be available by end of this fiscal i.e., Q4FY26.
items.target: Scale up MMA capacity to 360 KT by Q4 FY26
items.actual: Fuel additives capacity expanded from 290 KTPA to 360 KTPA, reported completed in Q1 FY27 call (Aug 2026).
items.note: Management achieved the targeted 360 KTPA capacity, though completion was reported on the August 2026 call rather than in May 2026.

items.quote: The project is progressing well as planned and we anticipate the JV to be ready for commissioning in H1FY27.
items.target: Aarti Circularity plastic recycling JV slated for commissioning in H2 FY27
items.actual: Original H1 FY27 deadline passed; timeline shifted to H2 FY27 with no commissioning update or actuals reported.
items.note: Management pushed the RESL/Aarti Circularity JV timeline from H1 FY27 to CY26 and then H2 FY27, leaving actual commissioning status unconfirmed in updates and actuals.

items.quote: However, given the capex intensity is lower, we still anticipate the net debt to decline in the current year.
items.target: Net debt to decline in FY27
items.note: FY27 balance sheet is not yet reported; borrowings stood at Rs 4,966 crore in FY26 and the Board approved an enabling resolution in October 2026 to raise up to Rs 1,000 crore to deleverage.

items.quote: From a margin standpoint, in the first 18 months, our target is to achieve INR250 crore to INR350-odd crore of bottom line from Zone IV, and I think we continue to push for that aspiration.
items.target: Achieve INR 250 crore to INR 350 crore bottom line from Zone IV in first 18 months
items.note: Phase I of Zone IV only commissioned in September 2026, so the 18-month bottom-line target of Rs 250-350 crore is still ahead.

items.quote: We have also started debottlenecking efforts to increase DCB capacity from 120 to 140 KTPA to capture incremental growth opportunities in this (DCB) segment.
items.note: No deadline was set for the DCB debottlenecking to 140 KTPA and no updates or actuals report its completion yet.

items.quote: With Zone IV getting commercialised in CY26, and that there are no other large projects in the pipeline, we anticipate the CAPEX for FY27 to be significantly lower.
items.target: FY27 CAPEX of Rs. 700 crore to Rs. 800 crore
items.note: FY27 is still underway; Q1 FY27 capex of Rs 180 crore is on track for the Rs 700-800 crore target, well below FY26 actual capex of Rs 1,125 crore.

items.quote: The total CAPEX on Zone 4 would be in the range of INR1,600 crore to INR1,800 crore.
items.target: Total Zone 4 CAPEX estimated between INR 1,600 to 1,800 crore
items.note: Total Zone IV capex has no fixed deadline and final project spend has not yet been reported.

items.quote: The revenue potential as we declared when the JV was announced was in the range of around INR300 crore to INR400 crore or so.
items.target: Augene Chemicals JV steady-state revenue projected at Rs 300-400 crore
items.note: Augene/Superform JV commercial production has not yet ramped up, making steady-state revenue of Rs 300-400 crore too early to assess.

items.quote: On Zone IV projects, they are expected to be commissioned in a phased manner during the current financial year.
items.target: Zone IV commissioning within FY27 and volume ramp-up throughout FY28
items.note: Despite a 3-6 month delay, Phase I of Zone IV was commissioned on September 7, 2026, while full FY27 commissioning and FY28 ramp-up deadlines have not yet passed.

items.quote: End of FY27, we should be in the range of around INR 9,500 crore to INR10,000 crore.
items.target: Gross block by end of FY27 expected at INR 9,500 crore to INR 10,000 crore
items.note: FY27 year-end gross block cannot be evaluated until FY27 balance sheet actuals are reported.

items.quote: Ideally, we would like to remain within 55 to 60 days kind of average levels.
items.target: Target net working capital cycle of 55 to 60 days
items.note: The ongoing 55-60 day net working capital target was stated in May 2026 and FY27 balance sheet working capital metrics are not yet available.

items.quote: The commissioning of that project is expected around September to October 2027 time frame.
items.target: Commissioning of long-term contract backward integration project expected in Sep-Oct 2027
items.note: Commissioning of the long-term contract backward integration project is scheduled for September-October 2027.

items.quote: On October 13, 2026, we also entered into a dedicated 10+ year manufacturing and supply agreement with a global specialty chemical major, representing a revenue potential of ~Rs. 1,500 crore.
items.target: 10+ year agreement with revenue potential of ~Rs 1,500 crore with commercial operations in FY29
items.note: Commercial operations under the Rs 1,500 crore long-term manufacturing agreement are scheduled to begin in FY29.

items.quote: So by 31st March 2027, most of it should get capitalized.
items.target: Capitalize INR 1,800-1,900 crore CWIP by 31st March 2027
items.note: CWIP stood at Rs 2,187 crore at end-FY26, and capitalization by March 31, 2027 cannot be verified until FY27 actuals are reported.

items.quote: In Zone-IV, we plan to introduce 5 to 10 products in FY27, expanding to 20 to 25 products across 5 different chemistry blocks by FY28.
items.target: Introduce 5-10 products in Zone IV in FY27 and expand to 20-25 products by FY28
items.note: The Zone IV product rollout targets span FY27 and FY28 and have not yet reached their deadlines.

promises.credibility: Management delivered on scaling fuel additives capacity to 360 KTPA [T4.2] and commissioned Phase I of Zone IV in September 2026 [T3.5, T1.9]. However, execution timelines frequently slip and are quietly revised on subsequent calls, with the Augene/Superform JV missing its Q1 and H1 FY27 commissioning windows [T4.5, T3.6], the RESL circularity JV pushed from H1 FY27 to H2 FY27 [T4.6, T3.7, T2.6], and Zone IV delayed by 3-6 months [T3.5, T1.9]. Most financial targets—including FY27 capex moderation [T4.4, T3.2, T1.3] and net debt reduction [T3.3]—remain too early to judge.

what_they_do.text: Aarti Industries Limited is a global specialty chemicals company specializing in benzene and toluene-based derivatives, as well as performance-enhancing octane boosters for the energy sector. The company operates integrated manufacturing facilities and R&D centers, ranking 4th globally for approximately 75% of its product portfolio.

customers_and_markets.text: AIL serves over 1,100 customers across more than 60 countries, with a global presence spanning India, North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
Exports accounted for approximately 57% of total revenues in FY26.
Key end-user markets include energy and fuel additives, agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, polymers and additives (including EV-linked and defense applications), and dyes, pigments, and printing inks.

recent_developments.text: Commissioned Phase I of the Zone IV Jhagadia facility on September 7, 2026, operationalising the Calcium Chloride unit, 4,000 TPA PEDA plant, and sections of the Multipurpose Plant.
Expanded fuel additives capacity from 290 KTPA to 360 KTPA and debottlenecked DCB capacity to 140 KTPA.
Entered into a 10+ year manufacturing agreement on October 13, 2026, representing a revenue potential of ~Rs. 1,500 crore, alongside an earlier USD 150 million agrochemical supply contract.
Advanced strategic joint ventures including Augene Chemicals (Superform JV) for specialty chemicals and Aarti Circularity (RESL JV) for plastic recycling.

bull.text: Aarti Industries delivered record Q2 FY27 revenue of Rs 3,887 crore (+73% YoY) and EBITDA of Rs 418 crore (+44% YoY), backed by strong 3-year cash conversion of 2.77x CFO/PAT.

Management scaled fuel additives capacity from 290 KTPA to 360 KTPA (operating near full capacity in Q2 FY27) and commissioned Zone IV Phase I on September 7, 2026, targeting INR 250 crore to INR 350 crore in bottom line over its first 18 months.

The company secured a 10+ year manufacturing agreement in October 2026 with ~Rs 1,500 crore revenue potential starting FY29, while China's 13% VAT rebate removal and capacity rationalizations expanded NCB spreads and boosted Western partnership inquiries.

bear.text: Over the past three years, net profit fell 8.4% annually and free cash flow was negative at Rs -573 Cr, while EBITDA margin contracted 3 percentage points YoY to 11% in September 2026 partly due to pass-through math and INR 500 crore of H1 trading volumes.

Elevated raw material costs stretched working capital and pushed net debt past Rs 4,650 crore in Q2 FY27, prompting shareholder approval on October 31, 2026 for an enabling fundraise of up to Rs 1,000 crore to deleverage.

Management missed its H1 FY27 commissioning target for the Augene Superform JV (commercial production still pending in November 2026) and suffered a 3-6 month delay in Zone IV, while Energy rose to 50% of Q2 FY27 revenue amid winter crack softening risks and Chinese dumping in PDA.

watch.text: Monitor commercial production startup at the Augene JV, H2 FY27 commissioning of Aarti Circularity, and timely completion of the remaining 4 Zone IV chemistry blocks alongside the INR 1,800 crore to INR 1,900 crore FY27 CWIP capitalization target.

Track Q3 FY27 imported raw material supply chain gaps (such as Aniline), seasonal winter softening in gasoline-naphtha cracks from Q2's $20+ per barrel, and potential inventory write-downs on INR 800 crore to INR 1,000 crore of goods in transit if crude corrects.
Check the structure and timing of the Rs 1,000 crore enabling capital raise and whether maintaining a 55-to-60-day net working capital cycle reduces net debt from over Rs 4,650 crore.

about: Aarti Industries Ltd, the flagship company of the Aarti group, manufacturing organic and inorganic chemicals at its major facilities in Vapi, Jhagadia, Dahej and Kutch, in Gujarat and in Tarapur in Maharashtra. The company has a strong market position in the NCB-based specialty chemicals segment. [1]
